title: The Midnight Inheritance
description: A stranger dies and leaves you a manor on the hill. The will has one condition: you must spend the first night inside. A branching AI mystery adventure.

title: The Night Shift
description: Last hour of your shift at a roadside diner. A customer walks in — but the mirror behind the counter shows an empty room. A branching AI horror adventure.

title: The Last Signal
description: A salvage operator answers a distress beacon in deep space — and the wreck's registry matches their own ship. A branching AI sci-fi adventure.

title: The Read Receipt
description: The message you sent three years ago — the one that ended everything — just switched to 'read.' Someone is typing. A branching AI romance adventure.

title: The Ninth Door
description: Every map of Greykeep shows eight doors in the great hall. This morning there are nine — and the ninth has your name on it. A branching AI fantasy adventure.
